7 July 1983
Mr. Bill Hough
244 Hamilton Avenue
Los Altos, California 94022
Dear Mr. Hough:
Thank you for your request for information on Egypt and
EgyptAir.
As requested, please find enclosed our latest tour brochures
which I am sure you will find interesting and helpful in
planning your trip. These tours can be booked through your
local travel agent. Also, reservations and ticketing can
be made through EgyptAir's office at the above address.
We appreciate your request and hope we will have the opport-
unity to welcome you to Egypt via EgyptAir "The National
Airline of Egypt"
and to all our worldwide destinations.
Sincerely yours,
Pubeal is Queber
Richard W. Proeber
Sales/Interline Manager, N.A.
